authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

audit_focus.card: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen
graph_refs: graph:data/grixis/graph/nicol-bolas.json#metrics/Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen

value: Don't import Bolas planeswalkers; they belong to deck #42 (blueprint L61).
Not a generic Grixis combo shell.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Losing an eight-mana commander before it deals damage is catastrophic.
The upkeep tax delays the rest of the game plan.
No deterministic commander win; fast combo tables outrace it.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Mana Drain, Counterspell, Terminate, Sheoldred's Edict, Chaos Warp, Toxic Deluge, Cyclonic Rift.
value.protection: Boots, Greaves, Regalia, Cavern, Command Beacon.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Bolas's damage-triggered hand wipe is the engine every damage enabler and discard payoff is built around.
accepted_role.honest_note: The identity is real but the commander is weak: 8 mana with UUBBRR, an {U}{B}{R} upkeep tax, and no command-zone combo (blueprint L57). The only Spellbook combo in the list is Sword of Feast and Famine + Aggravated Assault, which doesn't need him. Expect a slow, low-end Bracket 4 control deck. The cycle 51 M1 review (bolas-01..09) verifies the damage-source lines and flags Ignition hitting your own creatures (bolas-04).

reviews.question: Can the deck rebuild after repeated removal across multiple permanent types?

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume combat or targeting is materially constrained. Identify noncombat pivots, answers, and any commander-native route that still functions.
